text.content:
Colonel Hansen's army, and the law in the Occupied Zone.

Turf: Pacifica: the Occupied Zone
Known for: Black-market Militech equipment; checkpoints and tolls; the open draft
Leadership: Kurt Hansen, formerly Colonel, NUSA Army. Second: Major Imogen Reyes
Allies & rivals: Enemies: the Voodoo Boys. Patron of the Pups
Hangouts: EBM Petrochem Stadium, Black Sapphire (#51), Eden Plaza (#52), Terra Cognita (#53), every checkpoint

Barghest was an urban combat and pacification unit of the NUSA 4th Army, at the point of the Unification War under Colonel Kurt Hansen. In spring 2070 it took the unfinished EBM Petrochem Stadium in Operation Midnight Storm, and the Pacifica offensive was a sure thing until the Arvin Accord stopped the troops at the city's gates.

Hansen ignored his order to withdraw, and his whole unit followed him. They carved out a large section of Pacifica and plunged it into a full combat zone. Washington declared him AWOL; Night City doesn't want the fight. Members wear NUSA uniforms with the flags cut off and a black dog's head on the shoulder.

The Occupied Zone

Inside, Hansen's word is law: martial law, curfews, ID cards with a dog's head on them, and trials by officers. Crime is rare, because the punishment is the wall. Barghest advertises an open draft: sign up, get fed, get armed, and get protected from the NCPD, the corps and the gangs. It takes all comers, and some too young; those are the Pups.

Barghest soldiers are soldiers, with real training, discipline and armor. Treating them like a gang is exactly the mistake they want you to make.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.25; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 04, 12
